card_pick.why: One silent 3D card flip (direction from-right) for all 4 title cards. Flip is a real @remotion/transitions presentation, a Safe CSS-3D pick, and the least recently used Safe move (left-behind, 2026-11-02): slide ran on canton (inside the last three videos), cube is not in the package and ran on quant, book-flip and swap are fresh but need the unverified canvas render flag. A quiet card turn fits a plain presentation-style explainer. Each card is its own pause scene (never the spine in TransitionSeries), flips IN over the outgoing cover, holds through the silent pause, readable for 1 s or more, and does not flip back out. No impact sound.

face_glitch_pick.why: Film burn is the only sanctioned face pick that is SILENT: every Blocks Max row carries a baked glitch sound and the post-mix lays the sound of any library row with no mute, which the no-sound-effects ruling (Mike 2026-11-11) rules out. It also fits the register: a plain, measured explainer, warm flash 0.38 s each side of the cut. Used on all 15 face edges, the 7 gated-face edges and the 8 screen-share edges alike (house rule #1c: a screen share takes the plain face pick). Keep the intensity low: three in/out pairs sit 4 to 6 s apart (F3, F4, F7). Advisory slot: film burn also ran on canton and AI destroying lives, see open questions.

melt_spin_budget.note: Zero by design. The brief is a very simple video in the style of a longform presentation with NO sound effects, and every library melt and spin carries a baked sound the mix cannot mute. Both cue-sheet candidates (melt D2 to C1 at 59.64, spin D10 to C3 return at 256.68) stay on the quiet cross-fade + scale-in.

consistency_check: ONE card move (rmn:flip) on all 4 title cards. ONE face pick (hand:film-burn) on all 15 face edges, gated face and screen share alike. Zero melt and zero spin rows. All 16 cover-to-cover swaps (text cards, the C1 diagram, the C2 and C3 charts) are the quiet hand:xfade-scale (0.35 s, 0.93 to 1); intra-card and intra-diagram state changes are spotlight states the comp handles, not rows. No AI stills, no Envato video, no clip inserts, no receipts, no punch rows, no light leaks. 35 rows = 4 card + 15 face-cut + 16 container. Zero library rows, so the post-mix lays zero transition sounds (lib_sfx 0), which holds the no-sound-effects ruling. Every move is expressible on the one continuous spine: overlays animate their own in and out, only the 4 self-contained card scenes use a package presentation.
open_questions: Face pick repeats (advisory, not gated): film burn ran on canton and AI destroying lives, two of the last three videos. It is still the pick because it is the only silent sanctioned face move; the Blocks Max glitch would put 15 baked glitch sounds into a video you ruled has no sound effects. Say so if you want the glitch anyway.

Marquees: both candidates stay quiet (C1 entry at 0:59.6, C3 return at 4:16.7). If you want ONE motion-designed moment, the C1 entry is the one that earns it (the only system-design chart), as a short melt-rgb; it brings one soft baked sound, so it needs your OK against the no-sound-effects ruling.

Card move: flip is the least recently used Safe move. Slide reads the most like a slide deck but ran on canton (inside the last three videos); book-flip and swap have never been used but need the canvas render flag nobody has verified yet. Overrule if you prefer the deck-style slide.

No punch-ins anywhere: every join inside a gated-face window sits within 0.5 s of its edge, so by rule F1 (9.7 s, the open) and F8 (7.7 s, the read) hold with no zoom step and no light leak. If the 9.7 s open feels static, that is a re-cut question for the spine, not a transition.

15 warm flashes in 6:13 with no music under them: the burn intensity is planned low, and 8 of the 15 sit on screen-share edges where the card or chart continues across the cut (0:28.6 D9, 2:51.0 C2). If those read heavy on the draft, the fix is a lower intensity on the screen-share edges, same move.
